title: Global Argo Supply Chain Journey
reason: Provides a detailed procedural explanation of the supply chain process for exporting pulses from the U.S. to India.

tasks.task: Describe the transportation of pulses from the U.S. to the port in the United States.

subtasks.text: Show the peas, lentils, and beans being loaded into rail cars at the Chester Montana facility.
Highlight the process of trans-loading the pulses into containers and loading them onto steamship lines.

tasks.task: Describe the import clearance and compliance process after the container arrives at the import port.

subtasks.text: Observe the product being cleared at the port of import and its custom clearance process.

tasks.task: Explain the distribution and sale of the pulses to consumers.

subtasks.text: Note the movement of the pulses from the temperature-controlled warehouse to retail stores.

tasks.task: Present the sustainable and environmentally friendly aspects of the pulses.
